facts.business: Shristi Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited is engaged in construction and real estate business directly and through subsidiaries, joint ventures and associates.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-provision of interest expense of Rs. 2,572.24 lakhs on borrowings from Srei Equipment Finance Limited and inability to comment on realisability of investments and loans in subsidiaries under CIRP; Emphasis of matter on going concern uncertainty and NCLT resolution plan for Sarga Hotel Private Limited

key_risks: Non-provision of interest expense leading to understatement of finance cost and losses
Subsidiaries under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) affecting realisability of investments and loans
Material uncertainty related to going concern due to continued losses and negative net worth
Default on borrowings from Srei Equipment Finance Limited
